config.tacz.client.render.crosshair_type: The crosshair when holding a gun
config.tacz.client.render.damage_counter: Damage counter reset time of target minecart, in millisecond
config.tacz.client.render.disable_intera: Disable the interact hud text in center of the screen
config.tacz.client.render.disable_moveme: Disable all fov effect from the movement speed attribute while holding a gun.
config.tacz.client.render.enable_tooltip: Display the gun/ammo/attachment id in item tooltip when advanced tooltip(F3+H) is on.
config.tacz.client.render.enable_translu: Should enable translucent while rendering block entity like gunsmith table or statue. Enable this option will result in ADDITIONAL PERFORMANCE OVERHEAD.
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_enable.de: Master switch of the built-in mesh loader. Off: mesh-pack guns draw without their poly parts (cube only), exactly as if the loader were absent. Models already loaded stay loaded - no restart needed either way.
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_poly_in_p: Mesh Poly Parts In GUI Previews
Render poly parts in GUI / preview contexts (inventory, hotbar, gunsmith table, item frames viewed through a GUI). Off: those previews show the bedrock model only.
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_poly_in_s: Mesh Poly Parts In Shadow Pass
Only meaningful with a shader pack: also submit poly parts into the shadow pass so mesh guns cast shadows. Costs extra shadow-map geometry per gun, so it stays off by default.
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_log_stats: Log one line per loaded mesh model (bone count, vertex count, translucent/illuminated/magazine meshes). Verbose on large gun packs.
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_max_rende: Beyond this distance (blocks, measured on the pose matrix translation against the camera) poly parts are skipped in world contexts. 0 = unlimited.
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_gui_max_v: Per-model vertex budget for poly parts in GUI / FIXED / HEAD contexts; models above it fall back to cube-only or the pack-provided LOD model. 0 = unlimited.
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_world_max: Per-model vertex budget for third-person, dropped items and item frames; models above it fall back to cube-only or the pack-provided LOD model. 0 = unlimited. Not consulted while the GPU world path is live for that gun - that path uploads O(bones) matrices per frame and has no per-vertex CPU cost to protect.
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_max_model: Log a warning while loading a model with more vertices than this. Purely informational - it does not change rendering. 0 = never warn.
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_gpu_bakin: Bake first-person poly_mesh gun models into resident GPU buffers, uploading only bone matrices each frame. Massively reduces CPU cost for high-poly (100k+ vertex) mesh guns. GUI and preview contexts always keep the collector path; world contexts are covered by the in-world option below. Falls back to the CPU path by itself if the GPU pass fails - the guard only flips an in-memory flag, it never writes this config file.
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_gpu_under: Mesh GPU: Resident VBO Under Shaders

Keeps GPU-baked mesh guns on the resident-VBO path when a shader pack is active: the pass is opened inside Iris' own hand flush, so it lands in the gbuffer and is lit by the pack's hand program instead of being re-transformed on the CPU every frame. Needs an audited Iris 1.10.x; if the flush hook is not live the submissions are refused and the gun falls back to the normal collector path. On by default since R3 (in-game PASS 2026-08-31).
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_gpu_world: Mesh GPU: In-World Contexts (Third-Person / Drops / Frames)

Keeps mesh guns held by other players, dropped items, item frames and display statues on the resident-VBO path: each gun uploads O(bones) matrices per frame instead of every vertex being transformed on the CPU. GUI, screen-embedded previews, the in-scope pass and shadow passes are refused at submit time and keep the collector path; per-light-level VBOs are cached (Mesh GPU: World Light Levels Cached). Falls back to the collector path automatically if the world flush hook stops firing, and the reason is logged once per distinct cause.

Also keeps in-world mesh guns on the resident-VBO path when a shader pack is active, lit through the pack's entity program (the custom pipeline is registered with IrisApi.assignPipeline(IrisProgram.ENTITIES), constant audited against the Iris 1.10.7 jar). Same audited-flush-hook requirement as the hand path, same automatic fallback. On by default since R3 (in-game PASS 2026-08-31).
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_gpu_light: Mesh GPU: World Light Levels Cached

How many quantized light levels of baked world VBOs to keep per gun model (LRU, 1-16). Upstream TML caches 8 unquantized levels; this port quantizes light first (4 steps each for block and sky light), so 4 covers nearly every scene. Each cached level costs GPU memory proportional to the model's vertex count. First-person baking is unaffected - it keeps a single level.
config.tacz.client.render.mesh_world_ful: Within this distance (blocks), high-poly mesh guns in the world (third-person, dropped items, item frames, display statues) always render in full detail, ignoring the vertex budget. Without this, dense guns lacking a pack-provided LOD model would vanish to cube-only right in front of you. Beyond this distance the vertex budget applies as usual. 0 = no exemption.
config.tacz.client.render.first_person_b: Whether or not to render first person bullet trail
config.tacz.client.render.gun_hud_enable: Whether or not to display the gun's HUD
config.tacz.client.render.gun_lod_render: How far to display the lod model, 0 means always display
config.tacz.client.render.head_shot_debu: Whether or not to display the head shot's hitbox
config.tacz.client.render.hit_market_sta: The starting position of the hit marker when kill
config.tacz.client.render.kill_amount_du: The duration of the kill amount, in second
config.tacz.client.render.kill_amount_en: Whether or not to display the kill amount
Whether or not apply fadeout effect on the laser beam. Close this may improve laser performance under some shaders.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_mask_ena: Clip the scope body and reticle to the ocular while aiming, making the scope see-through.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_allo: Whether to run Picture-in-Picture optics when an Iris shader pack is active.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_debu: Diagnostic only: still capture, but do not composite. If the magnified image still overflows, the leak is in the capture/offscreen path.
Diagnostic only: paints the PIP composite coverage solid magenta. Whole screen = composite leaking; lens only = composite is correct.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_enab: Use a real magnified picture inside the scope lens while the world outside stays 1x. Default off; high zoom lenses are visibly softer.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_min_: Aim progress below which PIP is skipped; the aperture is nearly closed anyway.
Scopes below this magnification keep the classic whole-screen zoom; PIP costs too much softness below this point.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_rere: Draw the lens image by rendering the world a second time with a narrow FOV instead of reprojecting the frame. Native lens resolution (no screen/zoom cap) at the cost of a full extra world render per frame. Experimental; this port currently implements only the vanilla (no-shader-pack) path — under an Iris shader pack this toggle has no effect and the existing screen-space lens is used.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_reso: Render resolution of the second-render scope pass (1.0 = native). Not yet wired in this port: the second pass currently always renders at native resolution, so changing this value has no effect for now. Only meaningful when ScopePipRerender is on.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_shar: Unsharp-mask strength for the magnified lens. Weighted by zoom: 0 at 1x, full at 6x and above.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_pip_worl: How much of the scope zoom is applied to the world. 0 = pure PIP (world always 1x, softest lens). 1 = old whole-screen zoom (sharpest, equals disabling PIP).
config.tacz.client.render.target_render_: The farthest render distance of the target, including minecarts type
config.tacz.client.resource.enable_lazy_: Build heavy client assets such as models and animation state machines on demand. Inventory items are pre-warmed in the background when possible.
config.tacz.client.sound.default_sound_c: Max active normal gun sounds for the same entity and sound id. 0 disables this limit.
config.tacz.client.sound.first_person_an: Use a non-relative entity-tracking world sound source for first-person animation keyframe sounds. This can improve compatibility with physical sound mods, but may introduce slight stereo drift while moving.
config.tacz.client.sound.high_frequency_: Max active high-frequency gun sounds, such as shooting and animation keyframe sounds, for the same entity and sound id. 0 disables this limit.
config.tacz.client.sound.hit_sound_concu: Max active hit feedback sounds for the same entity and sound id. 0 disables this limit.
config.tacz.client.zoom.screen_distance_: Screen distance coefficient for zoom, using MDV standard, default is MDV133
config.tacz.client.zoom.zoom_sensitivity: Zoom sensitivity is multiplied by this factor
